description: Check whether a set of colors stays distinguishable for people with color-vision deficiency (colorblindness). Simulates protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia and flags the pairs whose perceptual difference collapses under simulation. A screening aid, not a legal accessibility (ADA/WCAG) audit.

colors.description: Hex colors to check together, e.g. ["#d7191c","#1a9641","#2166ac"]

name: checkPalette
title: Check a color palette for colorblind-safety
